title: Flip

objectives.text: She has an offer. It expires.
Villalba, on the radio, too calm

objectives.note: Nick hires muscle beforehand or fights badly; Augie survives (lethal: false). Cops among the targets are ordinary killable police (heat only).

objectives.text: Back to the loft before Lisle calls

fail.note: Wasted: retry from checkpoint (hospital flow, Gameplay).
Arrested: retry from checkpoint (booking flow, Gameplay).
Shown as '<Name> died'. Retry from checkpoint; offer a skip after repeated failures.

rewards.payNote: Calloway's deal and Augie's buy-out of the trucking contract.

mobile: Calm dialogue plus one cross-town drive (west on 37th, then up Ninth to the garage; back east on 38th, then down Seventh). No timers.
design: Calloway's deal: testify against Lisle for immunity on the insurance fraud. Accepting sets flag.nick_flipped (in dialogue), which opens B1 even if Teddy burned the wire. Augie, sick, admits the sale. If Nick's relationship with Villalba is −3, Villalba tips Lisle about Nick's visit. COMBAT (26 Nov): see COMBAT table in build_act23_missions.py.
conventions: FEATURE_AUDIT 'Mission conventions': cop kills feed heat only; 'Lose the police' gates on requireNoHeat objectives; fail only for standard reasons.
